name: ES Opening Acceptance With Participation Confirmation v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
origin: Priority 3 was sealed in es_candidate_macro_synthesis_v1.md before the closing-response and morning-to-lunch results were observed.
hypothesis: Opening value migration is credible only when participation migrates with it. If the second 15-minute auction has more volume than the first and moves both its value center and terminal close to the same side of first-half value, the repricing should persist toward the closing handoff.

signal.auction_center: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price (high + low + close) / 3
signal.participation_confirmation: second-auction total volume is strictly greater than first-auction total volume
signal.long_signal: participation confirmation holds and the second center and 09:59 close are both strictly above the first center
signal.short_signal: participation confirmation holds and the second center and 09:59 close are both strictly below the first center
signal.zero_rule: no trade when participation does not increase or center and terminal close do not agree

execution.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.long_stop_trigger: one ES tick below the first-auction center
execution.short_stop_trigger: one ES tick above the first-auction center
execution.stop_fill: the trigger price unless the stop bar opens beyond it, then the worse bar open plus one adverse tick
execution.entry_validity: skip if the stop is not adverse to entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: Absolute second-half volume almost never exceeds first-half opening volume because of the opening clock's natural decay. The comparison was structurally biased and far too sparse.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: using volume ratios or thresholds beyond the natural greater-than comparison
using close, median, POC, or another center definition
adding center-distance, volatility, side, weekday, or regime filters
changing the stop reference or exit time
selecting years or directions after results
